# Voltaik AI

> Voltaik AI is a pay-per-sit solar lead generation and appointment-setting platform for U.S. solar installers and solar sales organizations.

Voltaik AI helps solar businesses generate and convert qualified consultations through AI-generated Meta ads, instant lead forms, an AI voice agent that calls new leads within 0-5 minutes, and automated SMS and email reminders that reduce no-shows.

## Core services

- AI-generated Facebook and Instagram ads for solar companies
- Solar lead generation with geo-targeted instant lead forms
- AI voice calling and lead qualification within 0-5 minutes of opt-in
- Solar consultation booking and pay-per-sit qualified appointments
- Automated SMS, email, and pre-call reminders for solar consultations
- Custom qualification criteria, setter scripts, and optional voice cloning
